senses.gloss: प॑रा adv. (only ˚— in subst. & verbs) away, off, forth.

1 पार॑ a. carrying over. m. crossing (only —˚), a man's
name;
 n. (m.) the further shore or bank, i.g. limit, end, aim. पारं
गम् cross over, go through, carry out. f. पारा N. of a river, पारी
milk-pail.
2 पार m. = पाल keeper, protector.
परकथा f. pl. talk about others.
परकार्य n. another's business.

परकीय a. belonging to another, strange, inimical;
abstr. ˚त्व n.
परकृत्य n. = परकार्य.
परक्षेत्र n. another's field or wife.
परच्छिद्र n. another's fault or flaw.
परजन m. strangers.
पार॑तस् adv. on the other side, beyond (gen.).

परदार m. sgl. & pl. another's wife;
 adultery.
परदारिन् a. committing adultery.

परदारोपसेवन^1 n. ˚सेवा f. intercourse with
another's wife.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
परदेश m. foreign or hostile country.
परदोषज्ञ a. knowing another's faults.
परद्रव्य n. another's property or goods.
परधन n. another's wealth.
परंतप a. vexing foes.
परपक्ष m. the party of the foe.
परपरिग्रह m. another's property or wife.
परपाक m. food or meal of a stranger.

परपिण्डपुष्टक m. who feeds on another's food,
parasite.*

परपुरंजय a. conquering the foe's city or
cities.
परपुरुष m. the husband of another woman.
परपूरुष m. = परपुरुष.

परपुष्ट m. आ f. the Kokila or Indian cuckoo (lit.
nourished by a stranger, sc. the crow).

परपूर्वा f. a woman who has had a former husband,
˚पति m. the husband of such a woman.
परप्रेष्यत्व n. service (of another), slavery.

परभाग m. supremacy, excellency, might;
 abl. ˚तस्.
परभृत m. = परपुष्ट.
परभृतिका f. female Kokila, a woman's name.*
परमक (f. ˚मिका) a. utmost, best or worst.
परमत n. the opinion of others.
परम॑ता f. the highest point, position, or rank.
परमदारुण a. most dreadful.
परमधर्मात्मन् a. very dutiful or virtuous.
परमपुमंस् m. the supreme spirit (Viṣṇu).
परमप्रीत a. very glad.
परमर्षि m. an excellent Ṛṣi.
परमसमुदय a. quite perfect or satisfactory.

परमाक्षर n. the highest syllable (i.e. Om) or
Brahman.
परमाणु m. infinitely small part or atom.
परमानन्द m. the highest bliss.
परमार्तवत् adv. very mournfully.

परमार्थ m. the highest or whole truth, reality
(abstr. ˚ता f.). ˚—, instr., abl., & adv. in तस् really, truly
(˚तः संकल्प्य taking for real*).
परमेश m. the supreme lord, i.e. Viṣṇu.

परमेश्वर m. a rich or noble lord, a prince or king
(abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.);

of Durgā.

परमेष्वास m. an excellent archer;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

परंपर a. following one another, successive,
repeated;
 f. आ uninterrupted series, thick mass, instr. in the course
of, along (—˚).
परलोक m. the other or future world.

परलोकहस्त a. sure of (lit. holding in the hand)
the future world.*
परवत्ता f. abstr. to seq.
परवारण m. chaser of foes.*
परवीरहन् a. killing hostile heroes.
परशु॑ m. hatchet, axe.

परासु a. dying or dead (lit. whose breath is going or gone
out).
परशुम॑न्त् a. poss. to prec.
परशुराम m. E. of Rama (R. with the axe).

परश्वध m. hatchet, axe;
 p. ˚धिन्.
परश्वस् adv. the day after to-morrow.
परःशत॑ a. pl. more than a hundred.
परस्तर॑म् adv. farther away.
परस्˚तरा॑म् adv. farther away.
परस्थान n. foreign place.

पर॑स्प protecting;
 n. = seq.
परस्पा॑ m. protector.
परस्पत्व॑ n. protection.

परस्पर (only the obl. cases of m. sgl., n. & ˚—
adv.) each other, one another, mutual(ly)
परस्परतस् adv. = abl. to prec.
परस्परादिन् a. eating each other.

परस्मैपद n. the form for another, i.e. the active
or transitive form of the verb.
परस्व n. another's property.
प॑रस्वन्त् m. the wild ass.
परस्वादायिन् a. seizing another's property.
प॑रःसहस्र a. more than a thousand.
परःसहस्र॑ a. more than a thousand.
पराका॑त्तात् adv. from afar.
पराक्रम m. sgl. & pl. bold advance, courage, strength.

पराग m. sgl. & pl. the pollen of a flower (poss. ˚गिन्),
dust i.g.

पारग a. crossing over, going through (lit. & fig.);
thoroughly familiar or conversant with (gen., loc., or —˚).
परागम m. the arrival or attack of an enemy.
पराग्वदन a. = पराङ्मुख.
पराग्˚वदनशालिन् a. = पराङ्मुख.
पराङ्ग n. the hinder part of the body.
प॑राङ्मनस् a. having the mind directed backwards.
पराचै॑स् adv. away, aside, off.
†पराजिष्णु a. succumbent or victorious.
परातर॑म् adv. further away.
परात्मन् m. the supreme spirit.
पराददि॑ a. giving up, delivering (acc.).
परादा॑न n. the action of giving up.
परानीक n. hostile troop.*
परानु॑दे (dat. inf.) to push away.
परान्त m. the final end, death.

पराभव॑ m. going away, parting, vanishing,
disappearance, also = seq.
पराभाव m. defeat, humiliation.
प॑राभूति f. = prec.
पारायण n. going through, perusal, study.
परायत्त a. dependent on, subject to (—˚).

1 परार्थ m. highest (or another's) advantage, interest,
business, or matter. ˚—, acc. & loc. adv. for another's sake, for
others.

2 परार्थ a. having another object, dependent on another
person or thing.

परार्थवादिन्^1 a. speaking for another,
representative (j.).

पराव॑त् f. distance.

पारावार s. the nearer and further shore;
 m. the sea.
परावृ॑ज् m. outcast.
पराशर॑ m. destroyer, a man's name.
पाराशर (f. ˚शरी) patron. from पाराशर॑.
1 पराश्रय m. dependence on others.
2 पराश्रय a. dependent on others.
परासेध m. arrest, prison.
परा॑स्य a. to be cast away.
परास्य॑ a. to be cast away.
पराह्ण m. the afternoon.

परिकर्ष m. ˚ण n. dragging about.
परिकल्पना f. bringing about, contrivance.
परिकीर्तन n. proclaiming aloud, boasting.
परिकोप m. violent anger.
परिक्रम m. ˚ण n. walking about, roaming.
परिक्रय m. purchase, hire, wages.
परिक्रयण n. hiring, engaging.
परिक्रामितक (only instr.) walking about (d.).
परिक्लिन्न a. thoroughly wet.
परिक्लेश m. vexation, hardship, fatigue.
परिक्लेष्टृ m. tormentor, torturer.
परिक्षत a. hurt, wounded.
परिक्षति f. hurting, wounding.
परिक्षय m. disappearing, decay, end.
परिक्षाम a. quite emaciated or exhausted.

पारिक्षित् m. descendant of Parikṣit, patron. of
Janamejaya.

परिक्षीण a. exhausted, vanished, perished, brought
down, poor, weak in (instr.).

परिक्षेप m. tossing about, moving to and fro;
surrounding, enclosing.
परिखचित a. inlaid, set or strewed with (—˚).
परिखा f. a ditch or trench round a town.
परिखिन्न a. wearied, annoyed.
परिखेद m. weariness, exhaustion.

परिगणन n. ˚ना f. accurate enumeration or
statement.
*परिगणितिन् a. thoroughly versed in (loc.).

परिगतार्थ a. acquainted with or initiated into a
matter.
परिगलित a. dropped down, sunk into (—˚).
परिगाढम् adv. intensely, strongly.

परिगृहीत a. seized, received, connected with,
possessed of (instr. or —˚).
प॑रिगृहीति f. taking together, comprehending.
परिग्राह॑ m. enclosure (of the Vedi).
परिग्रहण n. putting on, wrapping round.
परिग्रहीतृ m. helper, assister, ruler, husband.

परिग्लान a. wearied, exhausted;
 *averse to (dat.).

sacrificial beverage.
परिचक्षा॑ f. rejection, disapproval.
परिच॑क्ष्य a. to be rejected or disapproved.
1 परिचय m. heaping up, accumulation.

2 परिचय m. knowledge, acquaintance, familiarity or
intercourse with (gen., loc., instr. ±समम्, or —˚).
2 परिचयवन्त् a. acquainted, familiar.
परिचार m. attendance, devotion.

परिचर्य a. to be served or waited upon;
 f. आ = seq.
परिचारक f. ˚रिका male or female attendant.
2 परिचित a. known, accustomed, familiar.

 adj. —˚
possessed of, covered or adorned with.

पारिणाय्य n. furniture, marriage-portion.
परीणाम m. = परिणाम & ˚णाह.
परिणाममुख a. verging to the issue.*
परिणामिन् a. altering, subject to change.
परिणायक m. leader, husband (cf. परिणीत).
परिणाह m. compass, circumference, extent, width.

परिणाहवन्त् a. poss. to prec.
परिणा˚हिन् a. poss. to prec.

परिताप m. glow, heat, pain, grief, sorrow, repentance.
परीताप m. = परिताप & ˚तोष.

 causing pain or sorrow.
परितुष्ट a. much pleased by (instr.), very glad.
परितुष्टि f. high satisfaction, delight.

परितोषण a. & n. the same.

परित्यक्त a. left by, deprived of, wanting (instr. or

परिदेव m. lamentation, wailing.

परिपा॑न n. drink, beverage.

परिपा˚ल्य a. to be protected or maintained.
परिपीडन n. ˚पीडा f. squeezing, vexing, injuring.
